description: Source code for the LIS2DW12 accelerometer driver trigger handling in Zephyr OS, including interrupt setup, trigger configuration, and interrupt handling functions.

methods.name: lis2dw12_enable_int
methods.description: Enables specific interrupt pin for a given trigger type, configuring the device registers accordingly.

methods.name: lis2dw12_trigger_set
methods.description: Links an external trigger to a sensor event, configuring interrupt handlers and enabling the relevant interrupt.

methods.name: lis2dw12_handle_drdy_int
methods.description: Handles data ready interrupt, calling registered handler if available.

methods.name: lis2dw12_handle_single_tap_int
methods.description: Handles single tap interrupt, invoking the registered handler.

methods.name: lis2dw12_handle_double_tap_int
methods.description: Handles double tap interrupt, invoking the registered handler.

methods.name: lis2dw12_handle_wu_ia_int
methods.description: Handles wake-up interrupt, invoking the registered handler.

methods.name: lis2dw12_handle_ff_ia_int
methods.description: Handles freefall interrupt, invoking the registered handler.

methods.name: lis2dw12_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Main interrupt handler that checks source registers and calls specific handlers.

methods.name: lis2dw12_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback function that triggers interrupt processing.

methods.name: lis2dw12_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts in a dedicated thread.

methods.name: lis2dw12_work_cb
methods.description: Work callback for global thread interrupt handling.

methods.name: lis2dw12_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes and configures GPIO and device settings for interrupts.
